concept: Barcelona maker's workbench representing the six Lovable projects
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: a polished editorial illustration for the right-hand side of a presentation title slide, vertical 3:4 composition. This is a new composition, not a slide mockup. Generate only the artwork, without slide text.
Concept: a Barcelona maker's workbench, representing six small useful apps built with Lovable. Instead of showing someone passively sitting on a sofa, show the things they have made gathered into one tangible miniature world on a warm wooden desk.
Composition: a slightly elevated three-quarter view of a single continuous workbench. An open laptop at the back anchors the scene. Around it, arrange six clear, recognizable physical objects with generous breathing room: a standing smartphone with a simple large circular contraction timer; a single conference attendee badge with a lanyard; a small street-cleaning truck on a short miniature street; a modest desk calendar with a few event blocks; a couple of chunky, playful isometric icon miniatures such as a house and a tree; and a small yellow playground slide. Treat these as a coherent still life, not a grid or disconnected panels. The phone and playground slide are foreground focal points, with the laptop and badge behind them. Every object rests convincingly on the same tabletop.
Setting: a quiet Barcelona studio at dusk, with a window suggesting tiled rooftops and a subtle distant Sagrada Familia silhouette. The city is a soft supporting detail, not a second main subject.
Style: warm, hand-drawn lofi editorial illustration with crisp ink outlines, clean cel shading, tactile matte surfaces, restrained detail, and a little charm. Confident, spacious, finished art suitable for projection.
Palette: near-black charcoal, deep muted navy, warm cream, walnut wood, and gold/yellow as the principal accent. Avoid rainbow lighting and oversaturated colors. Warm lamplight should connect the objects.
Framing: keep the important objects safely inside the central 80% of the vertical frame, so the illustration can sit in a rounded 3:4 crop. Let the tabletop and studio background run naturally to the edges. The existing slide places its headline outside this image to the left.
Constraints: no people, no robots, no magical floating interface cards, no holograms, no random icons in the sky, no dense dashboard, no logos, no legible words or numbers, no labels, no watermarks. Do not recreate any real app interface. Make a single compelling scene with clear visual hierarchy.
